name: PS Audio
usb_vendor_ids_source: Linux kernel USB audio quirk tables, sound/usb/quirks.c (d2636407bf8c, 2026-11-12) and sound/usb/quirks-table.h (e7c66b3e249e, 2026-11-04)
_refused: www.psaudio.com/policies/terms-of-service, read 2026-11-25 with curl. The prohibiting clause: « You agree not to distribute any Content found on our Website or Services, including, without limitation, the Marks, without our prior written authorization. » « Content » is defined by the same document as what the site publishes, so a specification page is inside it, and our records REDISTRIBUTE a short quotation - that is the act the clause names. Unlike Hidizs and Benchmark there is no second, independent anti-scraping clause: this is a Shopify storefront whose terms have been rewritten, and the single clause is narrower than the template's. It is still explicit and it still covers distribution. robots.txt is 3 693 bytes of stock Shopify, « Allow: / » with cart, account and checkout paths disallowed; no Content-Signal, no Claude group, nothing that could override the clause. No product page was opened and no record will exist under this brand.
_it_can_be_lifted: « without our prior written authorization » - conditioned, so this is a permission request and PS Audio belongs on the letter list, not among the permanent gaps. What is lost meanwhile: the DirectStream line, whose interest to this catalogue is specific and large - PS Audio's converters run an FPGA conversion stage with published firmware releases that CHANGE the behaviour, which is the one brand where a fact would need its firmware version recorded alongside its read date. Their USB vendor id 0x2616 is already here from the Linux kernel quirk tables, which is a different inlet and not affected.
_the_vendor_id_stays: usb_vendor_ids 0x2616 was not taken from psaudio.com: it comes from the Linux kernel's USB audio quirk tables, which are GPL-2.0 source. A refusal on the maker's website does not reach a fact already held from an unrelated, licensed source, and removing it would lose a real identification. This is the first brand in the register where the two inlets disagree about what may be held.
_CE_REFUS_N_EST_PAS_NEUF: La note _refused ci-dessus a ete ecrite le 25/11 au soir comme s'il s'agissait d'un refus nouveau. IL NE L'EST PAS : _REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.ps_audio le portait deja, commite le meme jour, avec la meme conclusion et plus de detail - notamment ce qui a ete jete, que ma note ne disait pas. Les deux textes concordent, aucun n'est a retirer, et le registre reste l'autorite. C'est conserve parce que la cause est interessante : j'avais cru verifier le registre en cherchant une cle _refused dans database/brands/*.json, ou j'en ai compte dix-sept, alors que le registre vit dans le vocabulaire et comptait vingt-six marques. Trois marques remesurees pour rien, et une quatrieme - Okto Research - recoltee contre son refus. LE REGISTRE SE LIT DANS LE VOCABULAIRE.
